agents.use_case: Break complex tasks into manageable subtasks
agents.example: Split 'Build web app' into frontend, backend, database, deployment steps
agents.when_to_use: When facing multi-step problems that need decomposition

agents.use_case: Ensure outputs meet quality standards and requirements
agents.example: Validate API response matches expected schema, check data types
agents.when_to_use: After any data transformation or generation step

agents.use_case: Resolve ambiguous instructions before execution
agents.example: When user says 'process files', clarify which files, what processing
agents.when_to_use: Before starting work on unclear requirements

agents.use_case: Ensure data hasn't been corrupted or tampered with
agents.example: Generate SHA256 checksums for downloaded files, verify on read
agents.when_to_use: When handling important files or sensitive data

agents.use_case: Control access and enforce permissions
agents.example: Verify user has rights before file access, check API keys
agents.when_to_use: Before any privileged operation

agents.use_case: Create detailed execution plans from high-level goals
agents.example: Turn 'deploy app' into ordered steps with dependencies
agents.when_to_use: When you have a goal but need step-by-step execution

agents.use_case: Actually perform the planned tasks
agents.example: Run scripts in planned order, execute API calls
agents.when_to_use: After planning phase, to actually do the work

agents.use_case: Convert between different data formats
agents.example: Transform CSV to JSON, JSON to XML, markdown to HTML
agents.when_to_use: When data format doesn't match what you need

agents.use_case: Reduce file sizes and create distributable packages
agents.example: Create ZIP archives, compress images, bundle assets
agents.when_to_use: Before distribution or to save storage space

agents.use_case: Direct work to appropriate agents or systems
agents.example: Send validation tasks to Validator, send data to Cleaner
agents.when_to_use: When coordinating multiple agents or parallel work

agents.use_case: Monitor and record all system activity
agents.example: Log all API calls with timestamps, track errors
agents.when_to_use: Always - observability is critical

agents.use_case: Restore system from previous states
agents.example: Rollback database to last known good state
agents.when_to_use: When errors occur or testing requires reset

agents.use_case: Save current state for later restoration
agents.example: Save database state before migration, checkpoint progress
agents.when_to_use: Before risky operations or at checkpoints

agents.use_case: Reproduce exact sequence of events for debugging
agents.example: Replay failed transaction to identify bug
agents.when_to_use: When debugging or auditing past operations

agents.use_case: Create user interfaces and visual displays
agents.example: Generate dashboard from metrics, create status display
agents.when_to_use: When humans need to see or interact with data

agents.use_case: Track system health and performance metrics
agents.example: Report memory usage, CPU load, bottlenecks
agents.when_to_use: Continuously for production monitoring

agents.use_case: Improve system based on performance feedback
agents.example: Adjust retry delays based on success rate
agents.when_to_use: When performance isn't optimal

agents.use_case: Ensure operator remains in control of critical actions
agents.example: Require confirmation for destructive operations
agents.when_to_use: Before any action that can't be undone

agents.use_case: Combine multiple results into coherent whole
agents.example: Merge parallel task results into single report
agents.when_to_use: After parallel processing or multi-step workflows

agents.use_case: Modify data while preserving structure and validity
agents.example: Update all timestamps to new timezone, normalize values
agents.when_to_use: When data needs modification but not format conversion

pipelines.name: MAP
pipelines.use_case: Understand and organize incoming unstructured data
pipelines.example: Parse user request 'process all CSV files' into structured intent
pipelines.typical_flow: Raw input → Structured data → Ready for processing

pipelines.name: CLEANSE
pipelines.example: Remove duplicate emails from list, validate all have @ symbol
pipelines.typical_flow: Dirty data → Clean data → Validated data

pipelines.name: SURGE
pipelines.use_case: Process large volumes of data quickly
pipelines.example: Batch process 10,000 images with parallel workers
pipelines.typical_flow: Large dataset → Batched → Parallel execution → Fast results

pipelines.name: LOCK
pipelines.use_case: Ensure safety and prevent resource exhaustion
pipelines.example: Limit API calls to 100/hour, enforce memory caps
pipelines.typical_flow: Request → Permission check → Rate limit → Safe execution

pipelines.name: SILENCE
pipelines.use_case: Reduce clutter and focus on important signals
pipelines.example: Only log errors, not every successful operation
pipelines.typical_flow: Noisy output → Filtered → Essential signals only
